description: Developing and Using an Index to Guide Water Supply Decisions is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Florida | Water Institute; Florida Water and Climate Alliance; NOAA Climate Program Office | Sectoral Applications Research Program. It's not easy to keep faucets flowing year-round in southwest Florida. To make sure their customers can get ample clean water at a good price (even through dry seasons) water utility managers crafted a useful index to help them decide which water sources to use. Coverage: Florida (2015). The toolkit gives Florida as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
